#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

struct Tuple {
    long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

long f(long p, int a, int b, int c, int d, const vector<vector<long>>& nCr, long mod) {
    p *= nCr[a][b];
    p %= mod;
    p *= nCr[c][d];
    p %= mod;
    return p;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    const long long mod = 1000000007;
    const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;

    vector<vector<long>> nCr(100, vector<long>(100, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    int count50 = 0, count100 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int val;
        cin >> val;
        if (val == 50)
            count50++;
        else
            count100++;
    }

    vector<vector<vector<long>>> dist(200, vector<vector<long>>(200, vector<long>(2, INF)));
    vector<vector<vector<long>>> dp(200, vector<vector<long>>(200, vector<long>(2, 0)));

    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;

    queue<Tuple> q;
    q.emplace(0, 0, 0, 0);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        Tuple t = q.front();
        q.pop();
        int x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z;
        long d = t.d;

        if (z == 0) {
            int rem_x = count50 - x;
            int rem_y = count100 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    int nx = x + i;
                    int ny = y + j;
                    int nz = z ^ 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.emplace(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz);
                            long val = f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j, nCr, mod);
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        } else {
                            long val = f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j, nCr, mod);
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rem_x = x;
            int rem_y = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    int nx = x - i;
                    int ny = y - j;
                    int nz = z ^ 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.emplace(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz);
                            long val = f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j, nCr, mod);
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        } else {
                            long val = f(dp[x][y][z], rem_x, i, rem_y, j, nCr, mod);
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[count50][count100][1] == INF)
        cout << -1 << "\n";
    else
        cout << dist[count50][count100][1] << "\n";

    cout << dp[count50][count100][1] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
